summary_en: 4,000,000 shares (9.3% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired at up to ¥1,000M aggregate via open-market purchase on TSE from 10 August 2026 through 30 June 2027. Executed to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: ENECHANGE announced on 22 June 2026 that its board has authorized the acquisition of up to 4,000,000 ordinary shares (9.3% of shares outstanding excluding treasury as of 31 March 2026) for an aggregate price ceiling of ¥1,000,000,000. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 10 August 2026 and 30 June 2027. The company states the program supports its strategic focus on improving capital efficiency and expanding shareholder returns in response to changes in the operating environment. As of 31 March 2026, the company held 1,072 treasury shares against an ex-treasury base of 42,867,212 ordinary shares outstanding.
